name: MILKVOID
source:
Welcome to Milkvoid !

A comedic small project serving as a first time game

You're stuck in an endless void with a bored out of his mind, milk loving test character, who just so happens to be very aware of his situation.

There may or may not be something more to this place though.

[from [url=https://devza.itch.io/milkvoid]itch.io[/url]]
